ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem gives that in triangle ABC, a=1, ∠A=π/6, ∠B=π/4. According to standard triangle notation, side c is opposite angle C, and the answer for the blank in the problem corresponds to side c. First find the remaining angle: ∠C=π-π/6-π/4=7π/12. By the sine theorem, c/sin C=a/sin A, obtaining c=a·sin C/sin A=1·sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6)=2sin(7π/12). Also sin(7π/12)=sin(5π/12)=sin(π/4+π/6)=sin(π/4)cos(π/6)+cos(π/4)sin(π/6)=√2/2·√3/2+√2/2·1/2=(√6+√2)/4. Therefore c=2·(√6+√2)/4=(√6+√2)/2.

method.method_draft: Use standard triangle notation where side c is opposite angle C and side a is opposite angle A; the answer format indicates the blank is asking for side c. From the text, read a=1, A=π/6, B=π/4. First compute the remaining angle: ∠C=π−π/6−π/4=7π/12. Apply the sine rule: c/sin C=a/sin A, so c=1·sin(7π/12)/sin(π/6)=2sin(7π/12). Then use sin(7π/12)=sin(5π/12)=sin(π/4+π/6)=(√6+√2)/4, giving c=(√6+√2)/2.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate construction instead of the sine rule. Interpret the requested value as side c=AB. Place A=(0,0) and B=(c,0). Since ∠A=π/6, point C lies on the ray from A making 30° with AB, so C=t(cos30°, sin30°)=(t√3/2,t/2). Since side a=BC=1 and ∠B=π/4, the vector from B to C has length 1 and direction 135° from the positive x-axis, so C=(c−√2/2,√2/2). Equate coordinates: from the y-coordinate, t/2=√2/2, so t=√2. Then the x-coordinate gives √6/2=c−√2/2, hence c=(√6+√2)/2.
method.CoT_raw: 按指定方法，把题目中要求的 C 理解为边 c=AB。作坐标构造：令 A=(0,0)，B=(c,0)。因为 ∠A=π/6，点 C 在从 A 出发、与 AB 成 30° 的射线上，所以可设 C=t(cos30°, sin30°)=(t√3/2, t/2)。又因为 a=BC=1，且 ∠B=π/4；从 B 看，BA 方向为负 x 轴，BC 与 BA 成 45°，所以向量 BC 的方向角为 135°，长度为 1，因此 C=(c+cos135°, sin135°)=(c-√2/2, √2/2)。比较两个关于 C 的坐标表达式：由纵坐标 t/2=√2/2，得 t=√2。再由横坐标 t√3/2=c-√2/2，代入 t=√2，得 √6/2=c-√2/2，所以 c=(√6+√2)/2。
